author: Praxis II
title: BRBG-AR(main-only): Global covariates without interactions + DAQB
abstract: Isolate augmented design effect without batch interactions: design = [B, log_total_counts, frac_zeros]; ridge l2=1e-3; residualization schedule and DAQB unchanged (λ=0.7, γ_max=0.74; δ=0.15, k_density=20; k=48; binary edges + true distances). Hypothesis: main covariates avoid Cell_cycle loss seen with interactions.
